values.meaning: Flame orbit duration (max time flames can still fire)
values.quote: conjures three flames which orbit her clockwise for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Each flame targets a visible enemy 0.25s after cast by priority, or 0.4s after cast targets the nearest visible enemy in range; only three flames total exist per cast, so at most one primary hit and two subsequent (40%) hits land on a single target.
mechanics.quote: After {{fd|0.25}} seconds of the cast, each flame targets a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy based on priority, or after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, simply targets the closest visible enemy in range. Each flame deals {{as|magic damage}}, with subsequent flames against a target dealing 40% damage.

mechanics.claim: Flames prioritize champions Charmed, then other champions, then killable minions, then the target of Ahri's last basic attack within 3 seconds, which determines whether the dummy (an enemy champion) receives all three flames.
mechanics.quote: Flames prioritize enemy champions hit by ''{{ai|Charm|Ahri}}'', then enemy {{tip|champion|champions}}, then minions that would die to ''Fox-Fire's'' damage, and then the target of '''Ahri's''' last basic attack within 3 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Fox-Fire's damage against minions is doubled below 20% max health; this does not apply to champion targets.
mechanics.quote: ''Fox-Fire's'' damage is doubled against {{tip|minions}} below {{sti|{{as|20% '''maximum''' health}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The ability's damage is recalculated from Ahri's current stats when each flame lands, not locked in at cast time.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown begins only after the ability's effect (flames) finishes resolving, not on cast.
Fox-Fire's missiles can be blocked by spell shields.
Unused Fox-Fires fizzle if Ahri dies before they fire.
mechanics.quote: Any unused ''Fox-Fires'' will fizzle upon death.
